meaning: A photo you take of yourself, usually with a phone held out at arm's length.
clues: You hold the camera out and point it at yourself.
The front camera on a phone makes it easy.
Some people use a long stick to hold the phone farther away.
A famous dictionary company picked this as its word of the year in 2013.
It has six letters and starts with S.
assumes: An avatar is a cartoon or picture that stands in for you
Photobombing is jumping into a photo
A panorama is a wide photo

decoys.meaning: A cartoon or picture that stands in for you online, such as in a game.
Jumping into the back of someone else's photo, often as a joke.
A wide photo made by slowly sweeping the camera across a scene.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, you asked a friend to take your picture, or set a timer and ran. Half of us were blurry.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Now the phone does it. Tip: switch to the front camera and hold the phone a little above eye level.

blank.sentence: I held my phone at arm's length and took a ___ of me and my dog.

why: It is a photo of yourself, so think before you post it.
